privacyPolicy.title: Privacy Policy
privacyPolicy.complianceBodyPrefix: This policy adheres to the Digital Personal Data Protection Act, 2023 (India). We are the
privacyPolicy.s1Intro: We collect the following categories of information:
privacyPolicy.s1AccountText: Name, email, phone number, clinic details
privacyPolicy.s1PatientText: Medical records, prescriptions, consultation notes (processed on your behalf)
privacyPolicy.s1UsageText: Feature usage, login times, device information
privacyPolicy.s2Intro: In accordance with the DPDP Act, we seek specific consent for:
privacyPolicy.s2MedicalText: Processing health records for consultations and treatment.
privacyPolicy.s2CommText: Sending appointment reminders via SMS, Email, or WhatsApp.
privacyPolicy.s2StorageText: Securely storing records on AWS servers within India.
privacyPolicy.s3Intro: Under the DPDP Act, you have the right to:
privacyPolicy.s3r1: Access a summary of your personal data processed by us
privacyPolicy.s3r2: Correct inaccurate or misleading personal data
privacyPolicy.s3r3: Withdraw consent at any time via profile settings
privacyPolicy.s3r4: Request erasure of data (Right to be Forgotten)
privacyPolicy.s3r5: Nominate a representative to exercise rights in case of death/incapacity
privacyPolicy.s3r6: Lodge grievances with our Data Protection Officer
privacyPolicy.s4r1: Active clinic data: Retained while account is active
privacyPolicy.s4r2: Inactive accounts: Data deleted after 2 years of inactivity
privacyPolicy.s4r4: Backup data: Deleted 30 days after primary deletion
privacyPolicy.s5BodyPrefix: All personal and health data is stored exclusively on secure servers located within
privacyPolicy.s5BodySuffix: . We use AES-256 encryption for data at rest and TLS 1.2+ for data in transit.
privacyPolicy.s6Intro: We do not sell your data. We may share data with:
privacyPolicy.s7Intro: For any privacy-related grievances or to exercise your rights, please contact our Data Protection Officer (DPO):

sla.title: Service Level Agreement
sla.s1BodySuffix: for all core services, measured on a monthly basis. Scheduled maintenance windows will be communicated at least 72 hours in advance.
sla.s3r1: All data encrypted at rest using AES-256
sla.s3r2: All data encrypted in transit using TLS 1.3
sla.s3r5: Data centers located in India (Mumbai region)
sla.s4r3: Role-based access and audit logging for sensitive workflows
sla.s6Body: SLA commitments do not apply during force majeure events, scheduled maintenance, or issues caused by third-party integrations outside our control.

dpa.title: Data Processing Agreement (DPDP Compliant)
dpa.s1Body: This Data Processing Agreement governs how Docita processes personal and health data on behalf of your clinic to provide healthcare workflow, communication, and operational software services.
dpa.s2r1: Clinic account and operator profile information
dpa.s2r3: Clinical records, prescriptions, and appointment data
dpa.s3r4: Regulatory compliance, auditability, and security monitoring
dpa.s4r1: Encryption in transit and at rest
dpa.s4r3: Comprehensive audit trails for sensitive actions
dpa.s5Body: Docita uses vetted infrastructure and service providers only where necessary to deliver platform services, under contractual safeguards and access limitations.
dpa.s6Body: The clinic remains responsible for validating and actioning data subject requests. Docita provides technical support for access, correction, export, and deletion workflows, subject to legal retention obligations.
dpa.s7Body: Data is retained for active service obligations and legal compliance windows, and is deleted or anonymized according to retention policy once no longer required.
